shared_elements: low-to-medium relief carving on a vertical face
horizontal band of repeating elements crossing the surface
arms and hands rendered on the shaft
anthropomorphic body implied on the lower part
surrounding rough stone rubble at the base
justification: Both are tall, upright carved stones set among rubble, each organised into an elaborated upper zone (masks/creature heads above a horizontal banded register) and a lower shaft where arms and hands descend toward the front of a body, which is a genuine if generic compositional echo. The manner of carving differs sharply: A is a densely packed, deeply undercut, highly ornamented frontal figure with almost no empty ground, while B is sparse, shallow, and schematic with large blank areas and profile animals, and the two are also presented in different media (engraved drawing vs photograph).
